limits: Sampled fit distances are not exhaustive Hausdorff bounds or source accuracy estimates.
Atlas decoded RGBA storage is calculated, not measured GPU residency.
Fresh scene-image files were downloaded and hash-verified, then supplied to headless Chrome on the existing development routes; shared shell/JSON came from that checkout.
Browser HMR update/reload messages were suppressed to hold each loaded case while other body packages prepared.
Development response sizes are not measured production network transfer.
